keyEvents.text: Goal! China PR 0, Bahrain 1. Mohammed Abdul Kayoum (Bahrain) header from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ahmed Rabeea with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Li Hao (China PR).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! China PR 0, Bahrain 2. Ahmed Bughammar (Bahrain) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mohammed Abdul Kayoum following a corner.
Han Pengfei (China PR) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! China PR 1, Bahrain 2. Behram Abduweli (China PR) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Wang Yudong with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Behram Abduweli (China PR).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, China PR. Mao Weijie replaces Yang Mingyang.

Substitution, China PR. Hu Hetao replaces Liu Yang.

Substitution, China PR. Ba Dun replaces Lin Liangming.
